summary: Tenant pin toggle triggers intermittent regional handoff and p95 latency spike
description: Issue summary: Customer reports periodic increases in p95 latency (~400-900ms above baseline) for API requests immediately following a region pin toggle via Console or API token-scoped change. Impact: Production inference latency spikes cause observable timeouts in their synchronous request paths and increased user-facing errors. Environment: Dedicated tenant on prod us-east with strict data residency to eu-west for a subset of tokens. Observed behavior appears tied to token-scoped pin updates and subsequent edge selection for a short window (30s-3m).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer toggles region pin for tenant via POST /v1/tenants/{id}/pin (pin to eu-west). 2) Immediately send a burst of 100 concurrent completion requests using token scoped to that tenant (seq length ~512). 3) Observe p50/p95/p99 before and after toggle. 4) Repeat toggle back to us-east and send another burst. 5) Capture edge request IDs and tracer headers for any slow requests.
logs:
Sample logs (redacted):
- 2026-03-10T15:02:11Z EDGE-req-id=edg_7a3bf2 token=tenant-abc action=pin_update scope=eu-west controlplane_tx=txn_9921
- 2026-03-10T15:02:12Z PROXY-req-id=prx_11ac slow= true upstream_edge=eu-west selected_backend=eu-west-kernel-3 node_latency_ms=720
- 2026-03-10T15:02:13Z PROXY-req-id=prx_11ad selected_backend=us-east-fallback node_latency_ms=850 auth_scope=tenant-abc note='fallback after pin'
- Traces attached: trace-url: https://tracing.redwood.ai/trace/edg_7a3bf2 (customer provided)
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: Control-plane propagation of the pin change is asynchronous; some requests route to newly preferred eu-west edge while in-flight control-plane or DNS state still points to us-east leading to mixed egress and handshake overhead. Secondary hypothesis: Token-scoped SNI or CDN cache not fully warmed for the new edge, causing TLS session warm-up and increased handshake times. Evidence: We see mixed selected_backend values within the 30s window after pin update. Auth logs show the token scope update at controlplane_tx=txn_9921 followed by a handful of requests routed to us-east for the same token. DNS TTL observed 20s on certain internal edges, and some client IPs hit a different POP due to geo-dns rounding. Related control-plane PR (see related_github_prs) introduced an optimization that batches pin writes; this may introduce a short propagation lag. Next steps: capture more tracer spans across multiple tenants, reproduce with synthetic load from different client IPs, instrument SNI selection path, and verify CDN and edge TLS session reuse metrics.
comments: Maya Patel (Support): Customer noticed p95 spikes tied to pin toggles during their routine environment maintenance window. Provided tracer links and request IDs.
Hector Alvarez (SRE): I see mixed backend selection in traces. Scheduling deeper trace capture and will replay with synthetic load from us-east and eu-west agent pools.
Eng (Control Plane): Batching changes introduced to reduce DB writes were deployed recently; investigating whether commit visibility to edge proxies is delayed under bursty writes.
Customer (FinCloud): We prefer an explanation and a short-term workaround; we can schedule pin changes during low-traffic windows but need assurance the p95 won't spike for customers in production.

Hector Alvarez (SRE): Short-term workaround: space pin toggles at least 90s apart and warm TLS by sending a low-frequency health request to the target region before production traffic. We're validating config to reduce TTL jitter on internal DNS flies.
resolution_notes: Workarounds provided: (1) apply pin toggles during maintenance windows and allow 90s for propagation, (2) pre-warm the target edge with a lightweight health/keepalive request to establish TLS sessions, (3) if possible, use console rollout canary instead of immediate toggle to reduce mixed routing. Engineering actions: control-plane team will adjust batching timer to commit pin writes sooner under dedicated tenant mode and add a short synchronous push to edge proxies for token-scope changes. SRE to monitor p95 over next 48 hours. Follow-up ticket created to track code change: INT-2026-controlplane-pin-flush (internal).
